{{reconstructed}}
==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Possibly from {{inh|sem-pro|afa-pro|-}}. Compare {{cog|cus-pro|*ʔaf-|t=mouth}}, and {{cog|cdc-pro|*faw-|t=mouth}}. Militarev and Kogan call the reconstruction very tentative, with {{m|sem-pro||*pVw-}} as an alternative. They derive the Ethiopian Semitic forms ({{m|gez|አፍ}}) from {{m|sem-pro||*paw/y-}} with a prefixed {{m|sem-pro||*ʔa-}} rather than from Cushitic, and take the Cushitic words for “mouth” to be cognates, not loans.<ref>{{R:sem-pro:SED|volume=I|id=35|entry=*pay-}}</ref>
